artifacts.notes: Source-reviewed, contract-tested, and compiled in the production build.

Desktop and 390px mobile renders inspected. Local proof, per-person AI acknowledgement, structured payload, analytics prohibition, no automatic expiry, no self-service deletion, and the published request path match current code and schema.

Source, typecheck, unit contract, and Chrome MV3 bundle inspected. AI recap defaults off, old ambiguous settings normalize off, acknowledgement precedes enablement, and the event-time gate reads current settings rather than a stale closure.
512px export inspected at original resolution; replaces the text placeholder that broke the extension build.
Homepage closure remains 28/30. Fresh privacy desktop/mobile and homepage reduced-motion captures were inspected; no overflow or errors, and reduced motion had zero running animations.

score.notes: Product truth, hierarchy, utility, participant choice, responsive composition, reduced motion, lint, typecheck, tests, and builds are strong. The inline extension notice adds one earned trust surface without changing the homepage composition or ritual flow.

known_risks: The hosted database and Anthropic path still require credentialed end-to-end proof before production activation.
Saved hosted records have no automatic expiry or self-service delete control; support-request handling remains an operating responsibility.
Final controller/processor, DPA, and data-region decisions remain human-gated.
Legacy extension dependencies require a separate coordinated security upgrade lane.
